# Golden vectors for the Nextcloud login-password derivation.
# Three whitespace-separated columns per row: derivation material in hex, ORCID iD, derived value.
# Derived value is "NC_" followed by unpadded base64url of HMAC-SHA256 over the ORCID iD,
# hex-decoding column one to obtain the raw HMAC material.
# These are fixed public test vectors. They authenticate nowhere: no deployment has
# ever held any of these values, and two of the four are constant bytes.
